name: craftflow
description: Judgment-driven engineering for Codex: understand the problem, choose a proportionate change, and verify the result.

interface.shortDescription: Make the right change with engineering judgment.
interface.longDescription: Understand the problem, choose a proportionate change, and verify the result. Coordinate dependent work with focused architecture, code quality, refactoring, React, TanStack Query, and TypeScript expertise. Each skill also works independently.
defaultPrompt: Use $craftflow-orchestrator to assess the problem and propose the right scope of change without editing code.
Use $craftflow-orchestrator to implement the approved change and verify integration.
Use $craftflow-orchestrator to resume this task and reconcile its current state.
